# omaGUI bundled bitmap fonts

The large heading faces are generated with `tools/font_gen.bas` from the
Liberation font family installed with the LibreOffice desktop distribution:

- `font_liberation_sans_18_bold.bi` uses Liberation Sans Bold at 18 points.
- `font_liberation_serif_18_regular.bi` uses Liberation Serif Regular at 18 points.

The rasterized glyph tables are sized for the existing title blocks: the
generated sans face has a 21-pixel glyph height and the generated serif face
has a 20-pixel glyph height.  The runtime backend draws these alpha bitmaps
directly, so it never falls back to the host's pixelated default font for
these headings.

Liberation Sans and Liberation Serif are distributed under the SIL Open Font
License 1.1. The repository carries only the bounded printable-ASCII alpha
bitmaps produced by the generator, not the source TrueType files. The bitmap
files beside the includes are review atlases generated by the same command.

The small Arial-derived files remain for compatibility with existing omaGUI
layout tests. New application headings use the Liberation bitmap faces so the
visual result does not depend on a host font installation.

The generator command is:

```text
font_gen.exe <font-file> <point-size> <symbol-prefix> <include-output> <atlas-output>
```

The output is intentionally limited to printable ASCII because the existing
gfxlib text API consumes one byte per character. DD text outside that range
continues through the existing HTML escaping and fallback path.
